text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Takes money and moves stock in one transaction. A

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: repeated submit returns the first sale.

svg.text: What is expiring, what is below its reorder level,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what has not moved.

svg.text: Replenish

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /pharmacy/purchases

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Raise a purchase order and receive against it.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Approving it is a separate permission.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guards, branches and the things that refuse

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The counter sees the person, not the consultation

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Name, age and allergies — enough to hand the right medicine to the right patient — plus which visit an order came from. The diagnosis, the notes and

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the history are not reachable from here.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A clarification is the only route back to the prescriber

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Editing a signed prescription is not possible for anybody. Asking and waiting is slower, and it is the only version that leaves a record.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Receiving stock and selling it are both idempotent

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A retried receipt would otherwise put medicine on the shelf that is not there, and a retried sale would charge twice and move stock twice.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Raising a purchase order is not approving one

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The default splits them. A clinic that wants the pharmacist to do both grants the approval permission from Settings.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What this role cannot do, at the server

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Alter a prescription, open a consultation’s clinical content, register or merge patients, or reach billing. The

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: counter is a separate job from the consulting room and the permissions say so.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: routes: /pharmacy /pharmacy/queue/[id] /sales /stock /purchases
